changes: Integrates the preserved Cloudflare static website, trusted forwarding profile and D1 search adapter behind existing selectable engines.
Bounds actual proxy request bodies, pins forwarded requests to the configured origin and prevents caching of dynamic account responses.
Records the source research, customer launch schedule, founder checklist and funding preparation.

retained_failed_attempts: The first browser pass was interrupted after four passing hosts. A separately recorded recovery pass completed all ten hosts.
The first Cloudflare asset attempt opened an upload session but stopped before uploading a batch or deploying a Worker. The second attempt deployed the canary successfully.

Canary readback matched all 2,501 body digests but only 2,497 full header sets: alias noindex overwrote the existing nofollow directive on four Dot routes. The next candidate repairs this; no production route was cut over on this evidence.

limits: D1, R2 production body selection, personalized feeds and a paid Feeds plan are not activated by this release.
The later Cloudflare forwarding configuration uses request-limit version 2; restore the saved version-1 host mapping before image rollback to release 73.
Browser and transport checks do not establish task benefit or complete options, model or hardware data coverage.
